core_profile.title: Established Canadian Professional
core_profile.body: 35-55, homeowner, household income $100K+. In the accumulation phase: building wealth, not yet drawing it down. Has savings but hasn't fully optimized them.

sharpest_segment.title: Incorporated Small Business Owner
sharpest_segment.body: Earns through a corp, pays themselves salary + dividends, has business expenses to track. Most advisors solve one of their three problems. You solve all three.

why_they_hire.title: Grow & protect family wealth
why_they_hire.body: They're busy running a business or career and don't want to think about money. They want one trusted person who proactively stays on top of it for them.

what_makes_them_switch.title: Feeling like a number
what_makes_them_switch.body: Generic advice, no proactive outreach, not being called before tax season. Your birthday portfolio snapshot is the antidote: it signals you're paying attention.

how_they_find_you.title: Referral, then LinkedIn
how_they_find_you.body: Almost never a cold ad. They ask a peer they trust, or they've been reading your content for months and finally reach out when the moment is right.

where_they_live_online.title: LinkedIn + WhatsApp
where_they_live_online.body: LinkedIn for professional identity and learning. WhatsApp for community and warm conversation. Instagram is leisure, not where financial decisions get made.

insights.title: Incorporated business owners are your sharpest differentiator
insights.body: This segment has three linked problems (corporate tax optimization, personal investments, and expense tracking) that most advisors address separately. Your suite solves all three, which is a rare offer.
insights.action: Lead with the incorporated angle in your content and pitch; it filters out the wrong prospects and attracts exactly the client who stays longest.

insights.title: LinkedIn, not Instagram, and most advisors in your space are doing it wrong
insights.body: Most Canadian financial advisors on LinkedIn post the same compliance-safe content that says nothing. Almost none are publishing content specifically for incorporated small business owners. That gap is your opening.
insights.action: Post on LinkedIn 2-3x per week on topics your target client actually searches: "how to pay yourself from a corporation", "FHSA vs RRSP for business owners", "receipt tracking for the self-employed".

insights.title: Your birthday portfolio snapshot is already a referral trigger: systematize it
insights.body: You already send clients a personalized portfolio snapshot on their birthday. That moment of delight is the highest-intent referral window you have.
insights.action: Add one line: "If you have a friend who'd love this kind of proactive planning, I have two spots open this quarter."

insights.title: Your WhatsApp group is high-intent: design for DMs, not consumption
insights.body: Members who join a financial WhatsApp group are already warm. The goal isn't to educate; it's to make people raise their hand.
insights.action: End every broadcast with a low-friction prompt: "Reply if this applies to you" or "DM me, I'll walk you through the numbers."

channel_plan.what_to_do: 2-3 posts/week: tax tips for incorporated owners, FHSA/RRSP myth-busting, anonymized case studies
channel_plan.expected_outcome: Inbound DMs from professionals; establishes expert positioning

channel_plan.what_to_do: 1-2 broadcasts/week ending with a specific CTA. Follow up every reply within 24 hrs
channel_plan.expected_outcome: 2-4 qualified DMs per month from warm audience

channel_plan.what_to_do: Add one referral ask to birthday portfolio snapshot. Track referrals in a simple sheet
channel_plan.expected_outcome: 1-2 referred intros per quarter per active referrer

channel_plan.what_to_do: Repurpose LinkedIn content as Reels or carousels. Lighter cadence (1x/week)
channel_plan.expected_outcome: Brand awareness with younger segment; secondary priority

channel_plan.what_to_do: Only once organic content is converting. Test a $300/mo budget on LinkedIn Lead Gen forms targeting incorporated professionals
channel_plan.expected_outcome: Predictable lead flow once message is proven organically

hashtags.guidance: Use 3-5 per post. Mix one high-volume tag (broad reach) with two niche tags (right audience). Avoid stuffing: LinkedIn's algorithm deprioritizes posts with more than 5 tags.

actions_30_day.title: LinkedIn audit + first post
actions_30_day.detail: Update your LinkedIn headline to call out incorporated small business owners specifically. Publish your first post: "3 tax mistakes incorporated owners make with their investments".

actions_30_day.title: Systematize the birthday referral ask
actions_30_day.detail: Add one referral line to your existing birthday snapshot template. Build a simple tracker (a Google Sheet works): Name, Date sent, Referral asked Y/N, Referral received.

actions_30_day.title: WhatsApp broadcast redesign
actions_30_day.detail: Rewrite your next three WhatsApp messages to end with a specific prompt instead of pure information. Note which ones get replies; repeat the format that works.

actions_30_day.title: Publish your second content series
actions_30_day.detail: Based on what got engagement in weeks 1-2, double down on the angle that landed.

validation_questions.question: What share of your current best clients are incorporated business owners, and is that a segment you're actively targeting, or one that found you organically?
validation_questions.why_it_matters: Knowing this tells you whether to lead with the incorporated angle in all channels, or treat it as a niche play alongside the broader professional audience.

validation_questions.question: How many people are in the WhatsApp group, and what does engagement look like today: reads, replies, or mostly silence?
validation_questions.why_it_matters: If it's mostly silent, fixing engagement there is higher-ROI than adding any new channel.

validation_questions.question: What's your current referral-to-client conversion rate: when a client gives you a name, how often does it close?
validation_questions.why_it_matters: If referral conversion is already high, systematizing the ask is your single best growth lever. If it's low, there may be a trust-gap or follow-up process to fix first.
